title: ICYMI: TSMC profit jumps nearly 70% on AI demand, but margin outlook weighs on shares

The share reaction shows how high expectations are, though: a beat alone is no longer enough, and investors are now trading margins and cash flow. Taiwan's equity benchmark, where TSMC carries a heavy weighting, is likely to take its lead from how the stock trades in Taipei. Higher planned capital spending is a positive read-through for equipment makers. --- Background: TSMC set for sixth straight record profit as AI demand lifts Q3 earnings --- TSMC delivered the AI boom in numbers and told investors it is not slowing, but with the beat priced in, the market chose to fret about margins and the bill for all those new fabs. title: Moody's cuts Nike outlook to negative, sees earnings falling into fiscal 2028
body: The outlook change is a modest negative for Nike's bonds and adds to pressure on the shares, though the affirmed A2 rating limits any immediate impact on borrowing costs. The extended timeline for falling revenue and earnings is the more market-relevant signal, because it challenges expectations of a near-term recovery. A negative outlook raises the risk of a future downgrade, which would matter more for credit investors if earnings fail to stabilise. Broader consumer discretionary names may also face scrutiny over how long restructuring costs weigh on profits. - Moody's has not downgraded Nike, but by pushing its recovery out to fiscal 2028 it has put a timer on how long the turnaround can drag before the rating follows. Summary: Moody's changed Nike's outlook to negative and affirmed its A2 rating The agency said the turnaround is taking longer than it previously expected It expects revenue and earnings to fall through the fiscal year ending May 2027 and into fiscal 2028 Nike's strategic actions are expected to pressure earnings over that period That pressure is expected to constrain Nike's credit metrics Moody's Ratings has revised its outlook on Nike to negative while affirming the sportswear group's A2 credit rating, citing a turnaround that is taking longer than the agency had previously expected. In a statement released on Thursday, Moody's said it expects Nike's revenue and earnings to decline through the fiscal year ending in May 2027 and into fiscal 2028.

title: New Zealand Food Inflation at 3-Month High of 2.4%
body: Annual food inflation in New Zealand quickened to 2.4% in September 2026, up from 1.9% in August, when it had marked the smallest increase since December 2024. This was the fastest pace of food price growth since June. The main driver was grocery food, with inflation in this category rising to 3.0% from 1.7% in August, making it the largest contributor to the annual increase in food prices. Inflation for restaurant meals and ready-to-eat food edged down slightly to 3.1% from 3.2%, but remained the second-largest contributor to overall food inflation. Prices for meat, poultry, and fish rose 3.2%, compared with a 3.4% increase in August, while fruit and vegetable prices fell more sharply, declining 1.8% after a 1.6% drop in the previous month. title: Ethereum whale's $13.45M loss reflects a year-long exit, not a fresh ETH dump
body: Ethereum whale's $13.45 million loss is a year-long exit, not a fresh dump A wallet that began buying Ethereum (ETH) near last year's market peak has now moved almost its entire position onto exchanges. On-chain analyst Ai Yi flagged the activity, Odaily reported it, and Binance News carried it on Friday. The headline figure, a potential $13.45 million loss on 15,361 ETH, checks out arithmetically. But it describes twelve months of activity, not a single sale this week, and that difference matters for how traders should read it. What the wallet actually did The investor started buying in September 2025 at around $4,600 and kept adding as prices fell. In total, 15,810 ETH was withdrawn from exchanges at an average cost of about $4,100, roughly $65 million. Between October 2025 and October 2026, the wallet sent 15,361 ETH back to exchanges at an average price of about $3,226. The most recent deposit came a few hours before the report, but its size was not disclosed. The wallet still holds 572 ETH. Why a deposit is not the same as a sale Moving coins onto an exchange often comes before selling, which is why analysts track these transfers. But on-chain data shows that coins moved, not that they were sold. Exchange deposits can also be used as collateral for borrowing or for internal transfers. The $13.45 million figure is therefore an estimate. It assumes every deposited coin was sold at the market price on the day it arrived.

title: Google's 40-fold quantum leap: big for Willow, smaller for Alphabet's share price
body: The result is a research milestone rather than a revenue event, so any lasting effect on Alphabet shares is likely to be limited, given the company's value rests mainly on search, cloud and AI. Smaller pure-play quantum stocks are more sensitive to sector headlines and could see sharper sentiment-driven moves. The encryption angle may resurface in crypto markets, but the gap between this result and what code-breaking would require is wide. The bigger signal is competitive: it strengthens Google's standing in the race for error-corrected quantum computing. - Google has made quantum computing's most expensive ingredient much cheaper to cook, but it is still working in a test kitchen, not a factory. Summary: Google says magic state cultivation cut errors about 40-fold on its Willow chip The result, published in Science, produced magic states with 99.99% fidelity Magic states are a key bottleneck, with some estimates putting their production cost at up to 95% of machine capacity The test used at most 54 of Willow's 105 qubits, and only about 8% of attempts passed every check Google says larger-scale demonstrations are still needed and has given no timeline Breaking RSA-2048 encryption would need magic states about a million times cleaner Google says it has demonstrated a way around one of the biggest bottlenecks in quantum computing, cutting errors in a crucial resource by about 40-fold on its Willow chip.

title: PBOC is expected to set the USD/CNY reference rate at 6.6947 – Reuters estimate
body: The fixing mechanism matters most right now because its message has shifted over the past month. For nearly a year, the PBOC has set its daily guidance weaker than market expectations, which traders read as an effort to slow the yuan's appreciation, and in late August that gap reached its widest since February, shortly after the yuan touched a three-and-a-half-year high. Through September, however, the midpoint has strengthened at a faster pace, narrowing its gap with market expectations and suggesting the central bank has eased its resistance to yuan gains. The fixing is still set weaker than models imply, so this looks like a loosening of the brakes rather than their removal. The balance Beijing is weighing is unchanged: a firmer currency supports capital stability and import costs, but too rapid a rise risks eroding export competitiveness while the domestic economy remains soft. The gap between each day's fixing and consensus estimates remains one of the clearest guides to how far the PBOC is willing to let the yuan run.--- The daily fixing is Beijing's quietest but clearest tool for telling markets how fast it wants the yuan to move, and after months of saying slow down, it has lately been saying go, gradually.Summary: The PBOC sets the daily USD/CNY reference rate, or midpoint, at around 0115 GMT, one of the most closely watched signals in Asian FX markets.

title: Two AI signals, one week: TSMC's boom and Dell's doubts show where demand really is
body: The split favours companies supplying the largest cloud and AI spenders, such as chipmakers and advanced manufacturing, over hardware makers relying on broad corporate demand. That divergence is likely to persist in stock performance until enterprise orders show clearer growth. Memory prices are the swing factor: a levelling off would pressure hardware revenue, while continued strength would delay the reckoning.
